slots.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
slots.author: Cointelegraph
slots.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

slots.title: Adam Back makes case for simpler security as Blockstream launches Bitcoin custody system
slots.author: Cointelegraph
slots.summary: Blockstream’s new custody system, developed with Thales, uses dedicated hardware for transaction signing as Adam Back advocates for offline security to reduce cyber risks.

slots.title: Amazon’s new Kindle Colorsoft is a premium e-reader with a premium price
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: The latest model is lighter and thinner than its predecessor and features an edge-to-edge display. But if you already own the first-generation Colorsoft, there’s little reason to upgrade.

slots.title: Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Nvidia poured tens of billions into AI startups under Huang. Without him at the helm, founders and VCs are bracing for smaller checks and lower valuations.

slots.title: Bitcoin miners pay Paraguay $350 million a year, but AI is pushing them out
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Contracts that sell power to a 4% slice of the world’s bitcoin mining at $44 a megawatt-hour expire on Dec. 31, 2027. Paraguay’s state utility calls the date final, and it has just signed a 15-year deal to power a Founders Fund-backed AI campus.
slots.reason: A major development affecting both AI and blockchain

slots.title: Bitcoin plunges to $68,000 as Anthropic IPO frenzy adds to market jitters
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Analysts see no direct link between Nvidia and bitcoin's decline, pointing instead to investor capital headed into Anthropic as well as a broader risk-off move.
slots.reason: Outside your usual reads — worth a skim
